from __future__ import annotations
import re, statistics, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/.treehouse/simplification-of-trajectory-streams-bec452/2/simplification-of-trajectory-streams")
OLD = Path("/tmp/simplify-iter2-baseline")
NEW = REPO / "build-release" / "simplify"
CORE_RE = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFY_CORE_MS:\s*([\d.]+)")
PTS_RE = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFIED_POINTS:\s*(\d+)")
PRUNE_RE = re.compile(r"WEDGE_PRUNE_HITS:\s*(\d+)")
ALIVE_RE = re.compile(r"ALIVE_CANDIDATE_ITERS:\s*(\d+)")

def run(bin_path, idv, eps, delta, timed=False, timeout=180):
    cmd = [str(bin_path), "--in", str(idv), "-e", str(eps), "-d", str(delta)]
    if timed:
        cmd.append("--time")
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"rc={proc.returncode}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}")
    core = float(CORE_RE.search(proc.stderr).group(1))
    pts = None
    prune = alive = None
    m = PTS_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    if m: pts = int(m.group(1))
    m = PRUNE_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    if m: prune = int(m.group(1))
    m = ALIVE_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    if m: alive = int(m.group(1))
    return core, pts, prune, alive

# --- correctness: point counts via --time ---
cases = [
    (1, 0.5, 200),
    (1, 0.25, 400),
    (1, 2.0, 50),
    (1, 299, 1),
    (2, 0.5, 200),
    (2, 5.0, 100),
    (3, 0.5, 200),
    (3, 299, 1),
]
print("=== Point-count correctness ===")
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>6} {'delta':>6} {'old':>6} {'new':>6} {'d_pts':>6} {'old_prune':>10} {'new_prune':>10} status")
ok = True
for idv, eps, delta in cases:
    _, op, oprune, oalive = run(OLD, idv, eps, delta, timed=True)
    _, np_, nprune, nalive = run(NEW, idv, eps, delta, timed=True)
    status = "OK" if op == np_ else "FAIL_POINTS"
    if status != "OK":
        ok = False
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:6.2f} {delta:6.1f} {op:6d} {np_:6d} {np_-op:6d} {oprune or -1:10d} {nprune or -1:10d} {status}")

print()
print("=== Interleaved no-timer medians (5 runs) ===")
timing_cases = [
    (1, 0.5, 200),
    (1, 0.25, 400),
    (1, 299, 1),
    (2, 0.5, 200),
    (3, 5.0, 100),
]
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>6} {'delta':>6} {'old_med':>10} {'new_med':>10} {'ratio':>8}")
for idv, eps, delta in timing_cases:
    olds, news = [], []
    for _ in range(5):
        c, *_ = run(OLD, idv, eps, delta, timed=False)
        olds.append(c)
        c, *_ = run(NEW, idv, eps, delta, timed=False)
        news.append(c)
    om, nm = statistics.median(olds), statistics.median(news)
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:6.2f} {delta:6.1f} {om:10.3f} {nm:10.3f} {nm/om:8.3f}")

print()
print("CORRECTNESS", "OK" if ok else "FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

from __future__ import annotations
import re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/.treehouse/simplification-of-trajectory-streams-bec452/2/simplification-of-trajectory-streams")
OLD = Path("/tmp/simplify-iter2-baseline")
NEW = REPO / "build-release" / "simplify"
RAW = re.compile(r"^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$", re.M)
PTS = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFIED_POINTS:\s*(\d+)")

def count_pts(idv):
    p = REPO / "data" / str(idv) / "simplify.txt"
    return int(p.read_text().splitlines()[0].strip())

def run_dist(bin_path, idv, eps, delta):
    cmd = [str(bin_path), str(idv), "-e", str(eps), "-d", str(delta), "--dist"]
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr[-800:] + proc.stdout[-800:])
    text = proc.stdout + "\n" + proc.stderr
    ms = RAW.findall(text)
    if not ms:
        raise RuntimeError("no dist\n" + text[-1500:])
    return float(ms[-1]), count_pts(idv)

cases = [
    (1, 0.5, 200),
    (1, 0.25, 400),
    (1, 299, 1),
    (2, 0.5, 200),
]
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>6} {'delta':>6} {'old_dist':>12} {'new_dist':>12} {'d_dist':>10} {'old_pts':>7} {'new_pts':>7} status")
ok = True
for idv, eps, delta in cases:
    od, op = run_dist(OLD, idv, eps, delta)
    nd, np_ = run_dist(NEW, idv, eps, delta)
    status = "OK"
    if abs(nd - od) > 0.01 and nd > od + 0.01:
        status = "FAIL_DIST"
        ok = False
    elif np_ > op:
        status = "FAIL_POINTS"
        ok = False
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:6.2f} {delta:6.1f} {od:12.6f} {nd:12.6f} {nd-od:10.6f} {op:7d} {np_:7d} {status}")
print("FRECHET", "OK" if ok else "FAILED")
